activities.result: Manifest request now uses a seven-second AbortController timeout and one bounded retry.
Candidate files load through a FIFO worker pool capped at eight concurrent requests.
Replacement files load through the same eight-request limit.
Activity files load through the same eight-request limit.
Each file records first-attempt or retry success and elapsed milliseconds.
One failed optional data file no longer clears every visible table.
Any missing file still forces manifest integrity to MISMATCH.
Successfully loaded candidate rows remain visible during an isolated file error.
Successfully loaded activity rows remain visible during an isolated file error.
Every requested candidate, replacement and activity file receives a visible LOADED or ERROR row.
Integrity and metric cards render before large tables.
Activity rows render in 200-row animation-frame chunks.
Candidate rows render in 200-row animation-frame chunks.
Chunking yields between batches to prevent long main-thread blocking.
Timeout errors are labelled separately from HTTP and JSON parse errors.
All individual data requests are bounded by timeout and retry limits.
Web health repair does not create or alter any runner.
Summary continues to show the shared runner heartbeat as stale.
SOURCE_* rows remain non-canonical and exact geometry remains zero.
Repository loader repair does not claim public HTTP/DOM acceptance.
